basic_profile.bio: A 39-year-old tech enthusiast residing in Greeley, Colorado. Passionate about cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology, often dabbling in online trading during free time. Works as a systems analyst in a local tech firm. Enjoys gaming, particularly games like 'Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order', and regularly tunes into Reddit for tech updates and community discussions. Prefers quiet evenings with family and is a proud owner of a Labrador. Usually active on Reddit during late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science and has over a decade of experience working in IT. Developed a keen interest in cryptocurrencies about two years ago after attending a local blockchain seminar. Continuously learning through online courses and community interactions.
